judge: Two judges, each a Claude agent shown only the match sheet's claims and truth, not which method made the claims, ruled on every claim without seeing each other's rulings. An adjudicating agent ruled on each claim where they differed. Rules: the same problem at the same place; a general claim states nothing; when unsure, no match.

matches.note: On G0.1 the code summary says 6 stories while the set shows 5 floors. This is the 'stories' item.

On G0.1 it sets the 20,299 SF occupant-load total against 19,099 SF, the same conflict as area_total. Its own sum is wrong (3,819 + 4 x 3,820 = 19,099) and it blames the wrong figure, but the conflict is the same.
Occupant load rounding (100 vs 102). It uses 20,299 SF as the area and does not flag the area total conflict. No truth item covers the occupant load figure.
Allowable stories for construction Type IIIA. The 'stories' item is the 6 vs 5 story count in the code summary, a different defect.

Names G1.2 through G1.5 and says each floor has one interior exit stair where two exits per story are required, so it states too few stairs on the third, fourth and fifth floors. It says G1.3 shows the stair, so it does not state stair_mid.

Same G1.3 stair marker as exit_capacity, but the defect it states is width: 21 in, below the 44 in minimum and unlike the 49 in on other sheets. It never says the 70-person capacity is below the printed load of 100. Unsure, so not matched.
The sheet index lists A7.1 Roof Plan, which is not in the set.
The A1.2 title block says THIRD FLOOR PLAN while the label under the plan says SECOND FLOOR PLAN.
Stair 1 is not shown on the first floor plan A1.1. It says the upper floor plans show the stair, so it does not state stair_mid.
Door fire ratings for the stair enclosure. No truth item covers ratings.

Adjudicated: Same door 4006, but the claim states a code defect: a pocket door cannot serve as an egress door. That defect would hold whatever the plan shows. The claim takes 'must be swinging' from the code and never mentions the plan or its swing arc. door_type is the conflict between the schedule and the plan, and this claim does not state it (contrast sheet_03 B06, 'does not match the plan swing'). Not matched under rules 1 and 9.
Room 100 on the first floor has no row in the finish schedule. room_name concerns room 219 on A1.2, a different room and floor.
EERO window sizes. No truth item covers EEROs.
